$comment: Canonical label set. `bin/harness labels` creates or updates every one of these on the repo's remote, so a label is never invented ad hoc at issue-open time.

labels.name: type: feat
labels.description: ✨ A new capability a person can use — commit type `feat`

labels.name: type: fix
labels.description: 🐛 A defect a person could hit — commit type `fix`

labels.name: type: docs
labels.description: 📝 Documentation and READMEs — commit type `docs`

labels.name: type: style
labels.description: 🎨 Formatting only, no behaviour change — commit type `style`

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: ♻️ Restructuring that neither fixes nor adds — commit type `refactor`

labels.name: type: test
labels.description: 🧪 Tests — commit type `test`

labels.name: type: chore
labels.description: 🔧 Build config, dependencies, maintenance — commit type `chore`

labels.name: type: release
labels.description: 🔖 Version bumps and release preparation — commit type `release`

labels.name: area: tools
labels.description: A tool's logic, spec, component or metadata under src/tools/

labels.name: area: shell
labels.description: The site shell — layout, header, sidebar, palette, the runners

labels.name: area: i18n
labels.description: Turkish and English copy, src/i18n, Localized coverage

labels.name: area: design
labels.description: Tokens, category tints, Panel.tsx chrome, both themes

labels.name: area: a11y
labels.description: Keyboard, screen reader, contrast, focus

labels.name: area: perf
labels.description: Bundle size, lazy loading, main-thread work

labels.name: area: privacy
labels.description: The browser-only promise — requests, shared links, storage

labels.name: area: tests
labels.description: vitest suites, the smoke run, fixtures, flakes

labels.name: area: harness
labels.description: The agent harness — contract, skills, roles, sync tool

labels.name: area: build
labels.description: next.config, the static export, dependencies

labels.name: area: ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions and the verification ladder in CI

labels.name: area: deploy
labels.description: Cloudflare Pages, what ships from the production branch

labels.name: area: docs
labels.description: README and repository documentation

labels.name: P0 critical
labels.description: Input leaves the browser, or the site does not load — drop everything

labels.name: P1 high
labels.description: A person hits this on a normal path — fix before the next merge to production

labels.name: P2 normal
labels.description: Real but survivable — schedule it

labels.name: P3 low
labels.description: Worth doing when the area is open anyway

labels.name: status: needs-triage
labels.description: Filed, not yet judged — the default for a fresh issue

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Triaged, scoped and ready to be picked up

labels.name: status: in-progress
labels.description: Someone or some agent is on it right now

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a named prerequisite lands

labels.name: agent-finding
labels.description: Found by an agent while working on something else, deliberately left unfixed to protect scope
